  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes networking, including pods, services, CNIs, and basic connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Foundational knowledge of RDMA networking and technologies such as RoCE or InfiniBand.
  • Experience with cloud networking in AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.

Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, operate, and maintain global, multi-vendor, multi-protocol networks supporting high-performance AI compute infrastructure.
  • Troubleshoot complex network and application-connectivity issues, identify root causes, and drive problems through resolution.
  • Analyze telemetry, packet captures, logs, and performance data to identify network degradation, congestion, packet loss, and capacity constraint

We are seeking a highly motivated Research Scientist to join our Research team. The role focuses on advancing the next generation of generative AI systems for professional creative workflows, spanning image, video, 3D, vector graphics, and design.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Post-Training Inference

About the role

The Model Shaping team at Together AI works on products and research focused on tailoring open foundation models to downstream applications. We build services that enable machine learning developers to choose the best models for their tasks and further improve these models using domain-specific data. In addition, we develop new methods for more efficient model training and evaluation, drawing inspiration from a broad range of ideas across machine learning, natural language processing, and ML systems.

As a Research Engineer within Model Shaping, you will develop a platform that enables users to customize open-source models with their own data. Working across the training and inference stacks, you will build and improve our Fine-Tuning, Reinforcement Learning, and Evaluation services – from ensuring a seamless path from post-training to production serving, to optimizing the inference engine for RL training workloads. You will collaborate closely with our product, research, and engineering teams to keep the API reliable, performant, and well integrated into the company's technical infrastructure. Above all, you will help build the foundational layer of the open-source AI ecosystem, enabling developers around the world to efficiently create high-quality models tailored to their specific applications.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build Together’s systems for customizing open-source models
  • Build integrations between the Model Shaping and Inference platforms to ensure a seamless path from post-training to serving production workloads
  • Add features to inference engines for large-scale post-training experiments, including optimizations for RL workloads
  • Make sure the service is stable and robust, participating in an on-call rotation and ensuring 24/7 availability of our platform

Requirements

  • Have 2+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning-based services in a production environment
  • Have hands-on experience with modern inference engines, such as SGLang, vLLM, and TensorRT-LLM
  • Are familiar with the latest methods for fine-tuning LLMs and other AI models
  • Have a strong software engineering background in Python or Go
  • Stay up to date with the latest advances and trends in the machine learning community

Experience in any of the following will make you stand out

jobs.title: Creative Producer
jobs.description:
Description

CapsLock  is a dynamic marketing company providing IT-enabled solutions for large North American partners. We specialize in scalable customer acquisition through data-driven marketing, creative production, and technology innovation.  Our teams collaborate across marketing, IT, analytics, and media buying to build, test, and optimize high-performing funnels that help clients achieve predictable growth across industries such as Home Improvement, Health, Legal, and Insurance.

We’re looking for a  Creative Producer  who thinks like a researcher - someone who senses trends, understands storytelling, and knows how to turn marketing insights into videos that actually sell.  Your role is not only production, but to lead creative evolution - generating ideas, refining proven creative approaches, finding new styles, testing them, and scaling what works. You’ll work at the intersection of project management, creative, analytics, and production.  You’ll also shape and pitch creative concepts that challenge existing ad formats and explore new storytelling angles.

Responsibilities:

Monitor and document emerging video trends across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other platforms.  Market and Content development Research

Research new video styles, not just iterate on existing ones.  Translate insights into creative hypotheses.  Project management, supporting various teams from idea to delivery  Ensure each concept accurately reflects the client’s value proposition and target audience.  Coordinate creators, influencers, and bloggers.  Develop and manage test plans with media buyers to validate creative hypotheses.  Review performance data (CTR, hook rate, watch time, CPA).

Understand a consistent “create → test → learn → scale” workflow for ongoing creative optimization.  Communicating effectively between marketing, creation and testing departments.

AI & Experimentation Mindset:

You know how to experiment with AI tools - from generating references in Midjourney to using Claude to organise your workspace. We don’t expect you to know every tool, but we value a “prompt-first” mindset - when you create faster than you search.  Requirements

Essential

3+ years of experience in marketing - ideally within paid social or performance marketing.  Solid understanding of short-form video formats and what drives performance on Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.  Comfortable collaborating with creators and bloggers: sourcing, briefing, and overseeing remote shoots.  Confident in interpreting marketing performance data.  Exceptional communication and organization skills - able to keep projects on track, people aligned, and expectations clear.  Strong attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to prioritize multiple projects effectively.  Fluent English - both spoken and written

Nice to Have

Experience in media buying or working closely with media buyers.  Familiarity with AI tools for generating or enhancing creative assets.  Video production or video market

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
CodePath is an AI-native organization building pathways into tech for the next generation of engineers, CTOs, and founders. We deliver industry-vetted technical courses and programs to learners across the country.

We operate with the pace and ownership culture of a technical startup. Our team runs on Claude, partners with Anthropic, and uses AI as a core part of how we work. The problems here are technically hard, the impact is visible, and the people are sharp.
With 40,000+ learners and alumni from 1,100+ colleges now working at 4,050 companies, including Amazon, Google, and Meta, we are reshaping who leads tech and how the industry gets built.

About the Role

Location:  Remote (United States, Europe, Canada, or LATAM)

Role Type:  Full-Time

Reporting to:  VP of Engineering

Compensation:  $148,000 to $190,000 per year for US-based applicants. Adjusted contingent on location for applicants based in Canada, LATAM, and Europe.  CodePath's educational programs run on our learning platform, a set of applications with functionality spanning admissions, course delivery, grading, career coaching, and reporting. These tools have been amazingly effective, but we’re increasingly seeing our limited design bandwidth holding us back in our efforts to take them further.  We're looking for our first  Senior Product Designer  to own the experience design of the platform: how a flow is structured, how people navigate, how an interaction feels. You'll also own the design system that keeps everything coherent as the platform grows.  This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You'll own the work end to end: talk to the people who use our products, decide how an experience should work, and hand engineers something they can build from.  We focus on what's most impactful for our students: the quality of the experience. A UI-focused contractor is available to you as a resource, and you'll set the direction they execute against.

The ideal candidate is a designer inspired by potential projects like these:

Designing the Learner Hub, the student-facing part of our Career Mobility OS: personalized career roadmaps, skills tracking, and employer-connected pathways

Building and owning CodePath's first design system: its interaction patterns and components

Untangling and redesigning the core platform areas no single product manager owns today, like accounts, onboarding, and navigation

Designing the interfaces for AI-powered learning tools, including tutoring, coaching, and grading

Key Activities

Design end-to-end user flows, navigation, and information architecture across the platform, and document them as wireframes and specifications engineers can build from

Own CodePath's design system: the interaction patterns, components, and standards that keep the platform consistent

Run lightweight product discovery. Talk to students, staff, and internal stakeholders to define what's needed, especially for platform areas and internal tools that no product manager owns

jobs.title: Staff Design Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Canvas, Multiplayer & AI team sits at the heart of what Miro is: an infinite, multiplayer surface where millions of people think together, run workshops, map systems, and build things. This team owns the core interaction layer that makes the canvas feel fast, fluid, and alive — from rendering and input handling to the real-time collaboration moments that define how people work alongside each other in Miro.  The team is also at the frontier of how AI shows up on the canvas — not as a bolted-on feature, but as a genuine collaborator embedded in the way teams think and create together. These two missions are deeply connected: AI changes what's possible on the canvas, and the canvas changes what AI can mean for a team. The work this team does compounds across the whole product and across the entire design and engineering organisation.

About the Role

As a Staff Design Engineer, you will work across canvas feel, multiplayer interaction, and AI experiences, owning the craft layer that determines whether Miro feels like a place rather than a page. This is a build-first role: you prototype in code because it's the most honest medium, and you ship because you care about what lands in front of real people.  You'll embed with product teams across the canvas and AI portfolio while holding a broader charter around quality and craft standards. You'll work closely with product designers, engineers, PMs, and researchers, and you'll be a key voice in how design engineering as a practice grows at Miro. At this level, the expectation isn't just excellent individual work; it's that your presence raises the quality of everything around you.

What you'll do

Own the core interaction layer of the canvas, responsiveness, rendering, input handling, and spatial transitions, working on the things users feel before they name.

Design and build the multiplayer moments that make working alongside someone in Miro feel genuinely different from working alone: presence, cursors, conflict, and co-creation.

Define what it means to have an AI collaborator in a visual, multiplayer space — shaping how AI outputs land on the canvas, how suggestions feel without being intrusive, and how generative results become part of a team's work.

Craft the moments of delight and magic that make Miro memorable, animations, micro-interactions, and transitions where the tool disappears and the thinking takes over.

Build the patterns, prototypes, and shared tooling that make the broader design and engineering organisation faster and more confident.

Write things down, teach by doing, and set a quality standard that propagates, contributing to coherence across the canvas, not just within your own area.

Collaborate closely with product designers, engineers, PMs, and researchers across Miro's canvas and AI portfolio.

What you'll need

Fluency in React, TypeScript, and CSS, you have strong architectural opinions that come from shipping, not reading.

Hands-on experience with canva

jobs.title: Senior Manager, SIRT
jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Role

As the SIRT Manager, you will lead Twitch's Security Incident Response Team, reporting to the VP of Security. You'll oversee a team responsible for detecting and handling security incidents, and be an advocate for lessons learned from incidents across Twitch. You bring expertise in threat intelligence, detection engineering, and incident response. Your team will work directly with affected teams to contain and learn from incidents. We encourage you to apply if you have a combination of the skills outlined below.

You can work from San Francisco, CA; Irvine, CA or Seattle, WA!

You Will:

  • As SIRT Manager, you will initially participate in, and graduate to escalation for, an on-call rotation of your direct reports on the Incident Response Team
  • You will identify opportunities for automation to enhance your team's efficiency
  • You will qualify reports or alerts of activity as security incidents using clear guidelines that establish what constitutes a security incident
  • You will evaluate the potential and realized impact of security incidents to Twitch
  • You will communicate security incident details, impact assessments, and response actions to leadership and executive partners
  • You will foster a culture of learning and knowledge sharing within your team and across the organization

You Have:

  • You have 5+ years managing a team of incident handlers and security engineers, or 2 years of management experience with at least 3 years of hands-on securi

jobs.description:
Scopely is seeking a highly motivated Analytics Engineer to join our Playgami team in Barcelona on a hybrid basis!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people worldwide daily.

Playgami is building the best SaaS gaming platform ever! The team strives to create the world’s best products for game production, operation, and insights. Powering many award-winning, loved-by-millions franchise games over mobile, web, and PC.

What You’ll Do

  • We collaborate with engineers, product teams, and analysts to create self-serve insight products that are fast, accurate, and elastic at a petabyte-scale
  • We work across the full data product lifecycle: designing new tracking plans, developing data models, ELT pipelines, and self-serve insight products like Looker explores and dashboards
  • We are stewards of data quality, ensuring that metrics are consistently reported across the catalog of data products
  • We work with cutting-edge tech (BigQuery, dbt, Looker)
  • We look forward and back, applying tools like BQML to predict player behavior
  • We empathize with our game product teams and departments to make their daily work more enjoyable and their products more successful
  • We often specialize in some part of the data stack and lifecycle but always aim to contribute across the full spectrum

What We’re Looking For

  • You love solving puzzles
  • You can translate needs into analytics tech
  • You have experience with the modern data stack (tools like BigQuery, Snowflake, dbt, Looker, Airflow, GitHub, and command line-based workflows) or hunger to work in that domain
  • You have first-class SQL skills and 3+ years of experience in a relevant role
  • You understand the importance of data modeling, like knowing your Kimballs, your star schemas
  • You value business context and improvement as much as you do first-class technical solutions
  • You love collaboration and take pride in working in high-functioning teams
  • You enjoy working in rapidly evolving, hyper-growth environments where every change presents an opportunity for us to grow
  • You love having fun at work. Ping Pong/Mario Kart skills are a plus!

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist III
jobs.description:
About Us:

Wrapbook is a smart, intuitive platform that makes production payroll and accounting easier, faster, and more secure. We provide a unified payroll platform that seamlessly connects your entire team—production, accounting, cast, and crew—all in one place. Wrapbook empowers production teams to manage projects, pay cast and crew, track expenses, and generate data-driven insights, while enabling workers to manage timecards, track pay, and onboard to new projects from any device. Wrapbook brings clarity and dependability to production payroll, while increasing the productivity of your whole team.  Trusted by companies of all sizes, Wrapbook powers payroll for some of the industry’s top production companies, including SMUGGLER, Tuff, and GhostRobot. Our growing team of 250+ people across the USA and Canada, including entertainment and technology experts from SAG-AFTRA, DGA, IATSE, Teamsters, Amazon, Microsoft, Facebook, and more. Wrapbook is backed by top-tier investors, including Jeffrey Katzenberg’s WndrCo, Andreessen Horowitz, and A* Capital. We have raised $130M and are in a strong financial position.

The Opportunity – Customer Support Specialist III (Remote - US)

We are looking for an enthusiastic Customer Support Specialist III to join our Support organization. In this role, you’ll ensure our  crew members  and  client users  have their product questions answered and technical issues resolved quickly, accurately, and with care.  Customer Support Specialist III's at Wrapbook work across a range of case types—from high-volume, repeatable issues to complex, high-context production scenarios. Depending on business needs and your strengths, you may be aligned to a team focused on Worker users and scaled support (Express Desk) or a team focused on non-Worker users and high-touch, relationship-driven support (Partnership Team). In all cases, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring payees are compensated compliantly and on time, while delivering a concierge-quality support experience.

What you’ll do

Own a portfolio of cases and inbound interactions (email, live chat, and phone via Salesforce), serving as the primary point of contact from first touch through resolution for crew members and client users.

Diagnose and troubleshoot product behaviors and production workflows: investigate issues, reproduce bugs, identify root cause, and advise on next steps or workarounds.

Manage your case backlog with clear ownership and urgency: prioritize work by customer impact, SLA, and escalation risk; proactively follow up internally and externally until issues are fully resolved.

Partner closely with Customer Success, Payroll Ops, Product, and Engineering to resolve customer issues, translating customer context into actionable technical detail.

Identify trends and product gaps: log high-quality bug reports and product requests in Linear (or similar tools), including replication steps and business impact.

Escalate urgent or production-critical issues

jobs.title: Senior UX Designer, Monetization
jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Team

The Twitch UX Monetization team is responsible for helping streamers monetize on Twitch through viewer engagement across our product experiences. A Senior UX Designer on the Monetization Team is expected to lead design work at the program level, work with senior XFN partners, represent work to executive leadership, guide and mentor junior designers and will report directly to the Monetization Director of Design.

About the Role

Designers at Twitch are involved in development from project conception all the way through execution and iteration. You will have the opportunity to do hands-on research and collaborate closely with engineers. If you are a champion for designing for humans and create playful and caring software for your customers, you will flourish on this team.

You Will:

  • Collaborate with a cross functional development team of product managers, engineers, and designers
  • Learn from streamers and viewers about the ways they use our services and their desires to accomplish more
  • Think creatively about how to solve problems that will sustain streamers’ communities
  • Give back to the design community at Twitch by using and improving existing patterns and approaches
  • Combine qualitative and quantitative information to develop hypotheses about customer motivations and use that to improve your designs
  • Present your work to others by participating in design reviews and feedback sessions
  • Mentor and grow junior designers and help instill best practice

jobs.description:

As a Research Intern in the Model Shaping team, you will work on one or more of the following areas:

  • Advanced post-training methods across supervised learning, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a newly forming team that will own one of the most specialised and business-critical domains in our technology landscape - Game Engine.  This role sits at the intersection of engineering, game mathematics, platform, and compliance. You’ll work on the tools, frameworks, and services that enable our mathematicians and game teams to build, validate, run, and monitor game logic in production.  This position is about deep ownership of a very specific technical domain: game engines, mathematical packages, simulation data, RTP monitoring, round details, and integrations with games developed both internally and by external studios.  You’ll be part of a small, experienced team with a high level of responsibility. The impact of this work is direct: incorrect game logic, missing round details, or inaccurate RTP monitoring can affect game delivery timelines, business performance, and regulatory readiness.  If you enjoy working close to complex domain logic, reviewing technical implementations, understanding how games work under the hood, and owning systems where precision matters - this role will feel like home.

Own, maintain, and evolve Playson’s Game Engine domain

Work on internal frameworks and libraries used by mathematicians to implement game logic and mathematical packages.

Review and validate code written by mathematicians, ensuring quality, correctness, maintainability, and proper usage of internal frameworks.

Contribute to the development and support of game engines used to run mathematical logic within our platform.

Take ownership of a highly specialised area where quality, accuracy, and attention to detail are essential.

jobs.title: AI Researcher, Core ML (Turbo)
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Turbo team sits at the intersection of efficient inference (algorithms, architectures, engines) and post‑training / RL systems. We build and operate the systems behind Together’s API, including high‑performance inference and RL/post‑training engines that can run at production scale.

Our mandate is to push the frontier of efficient inference and RL‑driven training: making models dramatically faster and cheaper to run, while improving their capabilities through RL‑based post‑training (e.g., GRPO‑style objectives). This work lives at the interface of algorithms and systems: asynchronous RL, rollout collection, scheduling, and batching all interact with engine design, creating many knobs to tune across the RL algorithm, training loop, and inference stack. Much of the job is modifying production inference systems—for example, SGLang‑ or vLLM‑style serving stacks and speculative decoding systems such as ATLAS—grounded in a strong understanding of post‑training and inference theory, rather than purely theoretical algorithm design.

You’ll work across the stack—from RL algorithms and training engines to kernels and serving systems—to build and improve frontier models via RL pipelines. People on this team are often spiky: some are more RL‑first, some are more systems‑first. Depth in one of these areas plus appetite to collaborate across (and grow toward more full‑stack ownership over time) is ideal.

Requirements

We don’t expect anyone to check every box below. People on this team typically have deep expertise in one or more areas and enough breadth (or interest) to work effectively across the stack. The closer you are to full‑stack (inference + post‑training/RL + systems), the stronger the fit—but being spiky in one area and eager to grow is absolutely okay.

You might be a good fit if you:

  • Have strong expertise in at least one of the following, and are excited to collaborate across (and grow into) the others:
    • Systems‑first profile: Large‑scale inference systems (e.g., SGLang, vLLM, FasterTransformer, TensorRT, custom engines, or similar), GPU performance, distributed serving.
    • RL‑first profile: RL / post‑training for LLMs or large models (e.g., GRPO, RLHF/RLAIF, DPO‑like methods, reward modeling), and using these to train or fine‑tune real models.
    • Model architecture design for Transformers or other large neural nets.
    • Distributed systems / high‑performance computing for ML.
  • Are comfortable working from algorithms to engines:

jobs.title: Senior Accountant, Content Accounting
jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Team

At Twitch, Content Accounting is responsible for managing the end to end financial and reporting obligations of negotiated agreements with content providers, influencers, production companies, and music rights holders. Our goal is to close our books in accordance with U.S. GAAP & internal accounting policy and meet our contractually obligated payout and reporting requirements. We support a diverse set of business stakeholders including content acquisition, music licensing, influencer marketing, and event production. We work closely with our legal, FP&A, tax and enterprise technology counterparts to accelerate Twitch’s strategy.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Accountant eager to help us re-imagine how Content Accounting operates with the growing capabilities of AI. Your core work will have you involved at every step of the process from contract ideation through to final payout—providing support for negotiation, drafting technical accounting memos, preparing cost and payout calculations, executing month-end close activities, facilitating payment runs, and delivering reporting.

A successful candidate uses GenAI tools both reflexively and responsibly to enhance the group's daily productivity. You are passionate about accounting, thrive in the details, have an understanding of how data flows through systems, and have demonstrated the ability to break down ambiguous problems into concrete steps. 예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

K-BOS(Krafton Building Operation System) 프로젝트는 2028년 입주 예정인 성수 사옥을 위한 빌딩 통합 운영 플랫폼 구축 프로젝트입니다.
구성원이 출입부터 공간 예약, 환경 제어, 편의 서비스까지 하나의 앱에서 경험할 수 있도록, 성수 클러스터 6개 동의 설비와 서비스를 단일 플랫폼으로 통합한 K-BOS를 구축하고 있습니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

K-BOS Project Coordinator는 플랫폼 개발, 설비 구축, 외부 파트너 관리, 인증까지 동시에 진행되는 복합 프로젝트의 실무 전반을 수행하는 역할입니다.
내부 부서간 조율, 외부 벤더 협의, 일정·이슈 관리, 계약·인허가 프로세스, 건물운영까지 프로젝트의 흐름 전체를 이해하고 챙기며, K-BOS가 일정대로 앞으로 나아갈 수 있도록 실행력으로 뒷받침합니다.

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • IT 프로젝트, 건설/개발/설계, 시설관리, 건물운영, 총무, 컨설팅 중 하나 이상의 분야에서 실무를 직접 운영한 경험 5년 이상
  • 경영진 또는 의사결정자 대상 보고 자료를 스스로 기획하고 작성한 경험
  • 계약, 인허가, 인증 등 행정 프로세스를 직접 운영한 경험
  • 일정과 이슈를 스스로 추적하고 관리한 경험
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • 5년 이상 FP&A(경영기획/재무기획/관리회계) 관련 실무 경력
  • 복잡한 사업 구조를 이해하고 재무적 시사점을 도출할 수 있는 역량
  • 경영진 대상 보고자료 작성 및 리포팅 역량
  • AI Tool을 활용한 재무 모델링 및 데이터 분석 수행 역량
  • 다양한 이해관계자와 협업 가능한 커뮤니케이션 및 조율 능력
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • 전사 또는 사업부 단위 손익관리 및 재무 분석 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 보고 자료의 시각화 및 논리 전개 역량을 갖추신 분
  • 게임 산업 특성에 대한 이해도가 높으신 분
  • 데이터 분석 툴 활용에 능숙하고, AI/자동화 도구를 활용한 업무 개선 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 영어로 원활한 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분

크래프톤의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

  • 서류 전형 > *과제 전형 > 인성검사 (Personality Assessment) > 직무면접 (Technical Fit Interview) > 종합면접 (2-3회) (Culture Fit Interview) > 합격 및 입사
  • *해당 절차는 각 포지션 및 후보자에 따라 변동이 있을 수 있습니다.
  • 상시 채용으로 채용 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Role

Join the Monetization team at Twitch, where we build the products that help creators make a living on the platform. You'll work on products like Subscriptions, Bits, and Gifting, and the pricing and packaging decisions behind them.

You'll partner closely with product, engineering, finance, and data teams to measure the impact of new features, design and analyze experiments, and apply causal inference methods to inform decisions where A/B testing isn't possible. The work ranges from high-velocity experimentation on consumer-facing products to deeper pricing, policy, and segmentation analyses where causal identification is the central challenge.

This role is well-suited for someone with a strong economics or causal ML foundation who wants to apply rigorous statistical thinking to real product decisions at scale. You'll need to be comfortable writing SQL, working with imperfect data, and partnering with stakeholders to turn analysis into product impact. Our team is based at Twitch HQ in San Francisco, CA.

You can work in San Francisco, CA; New York, NY; or Seattle, WA

You Will:

  • Apply causal inference methods where experimentation isn't feasible
  • Develop models and analyses that inform pricing, segmentation, and revenue optimization
  • Design, run, and analyze A/B experiments
  • Partner with product, engineering, and finance to translate ambiguous business questions into measurement frameworks
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reporting, and analytical tooling that support ongoing

jobs.title: [Corporate Brand Div.] CSR Specialist (3~7년 / 계약직)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • CSR Team은 크래프톤의 사회적 책임과 지속가능한 성장을 실현하기 위한 전략을 수립하고 실행하는 조직입니다. 우리는 기업이 사회와 관계 맺는 더 나은 방식을 고민하며, 게임 산업과 기술 혁신이 사회에 긍정적으로 기여할 수 있는 새로운 가능성을 탐색합니다. 이를 바탕으로 CSR 이니셔티브를 기획·운영하고, 크래프톤의 브랜드 아이덴티티와 연계하여 기업의 사회적 임팩트를 확장해 나가고 있습니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 크래프톤 CSR 전략 방향에 기반한 주요 CSR 이니셔티브 담당(기획, 운영, 성과평가, 포스트모르템 등 전 과정 수행)
  • CSR 관련 내·외부 커뮤니케이션 수행(구성원·유관 부서 대상 소통 및 협업 조율, CSR 메시지 기반 대외 콘텐츠 작성 및 배포 등)
  • 정부, 지자체, NGO, 글로벌 재단 등 다양한 파트너와 협력 네트워크 구축 및 관리
  • 국내·외 사회문제, 주요 해결 사례 등 CSR 관련 리서치 및 보고서 등 문서 작성

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • CSR 유관 경력을 3년 이상 보유하신 분
  • 사회문제에 대한 지속적인 관심을 바탕으로, 문제 해결을 위한 이니셔티브를 기획·운영해보신 분
  • 다양한 이해관계자와의 관계를 형성·관리하고, 다양한 의견을 효과적으로 조율할 수 있는 분
  • 글로벌 협업을 위한 비즈니스 레벨의 영어 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없으신 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • CSR 메시지 전략을 수립하고, 대외 홍보 및 PR 커뮤니케이션을 기획·실행한 경험이 있으신 분
  • CSR 활동의 성과 지표를 설정하고, 데이터를 기반으로 성과를 측정·분석한 경험이 있으신 분

크래프톤의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

  • 서류 전형 > 사전 인터뷰 (Phone Interview) > 직무면접 (Technical Fit Interview) > 종합면접 (Culture Fit Interview) > 합격 및 입사
  • 상시 채용으로 채용 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 필요 시, 인터뷰 및 직무 테스트가 추가될 수 있습니다.
  • 전형 일정 및 합격 또는 불합격 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일 또는 유선으로 개별 안내 드립니다.

필요 서류를 확인해주세요!

jobs.title: [HR Div.] 보상 담당자 (3년 이상 / 계약직)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

Compensation팀은 전사 구성원의 보상을 담당하고 있습니다. 끊임없이 성장하고 변화하는 글로벌 기업에 적합한 보상 제도를 설계하고 실행하는 역할을 합니다.
구성원이 회사의 방향성과 align한 목표를 가지고 합당한 보상을 통해 동기부여 될 수 있도록 고민합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 장기 보상 제도 운영: 주식연계 장기보상제도의 전반적인 실무 운영 및 관리
  • 우리사주조합(ESOP) 운영: 우리사주 입출고관리, 대출상환, 프로세스 관리 등 제반 실무 운영
  • 보상 시스템 운영: 쿼타북 및 HRIS(Workday)를 활용한 보상 데이터 관리
  • 보상 데이터 관리 및 분석: 데이터 추출/취합, 데이터 운영 지원
  • 보상 커뮤니케이션: 구성원 대상 스톡옵션, 우리사주 등 장기 보상 관련 문의 응대 및 가이드 안내 지원

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 기업 HR 조직 등에서 3년 이상 운영/실무 경험이 있으신 분
  • 숫자와 데이터를 다루는 데 익숙하며, 원활한 엑셀 활용 및 문서 작업이 가능하신 분
  • 유관부서 및 구성원과 원활하게 소통할 수 있는 분

jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

AI Transformation Dept.은 크래프톤 전사의 AI 전환(AX)을 주도하는 조직입니다.

현업 조직이 AI를 활용하여 업무 생산성을 혁신할 수 있도록 전략 수립, 기술 지원, 교육 및 직접 실행을 담당하며, 특히 AXI(AX Impact) 프로젝트를 통해 현업 밀착형 AI 업무 자동화를 추진하고 있습니다. AI DBA는 AI 시대의 빠른 DB 인프라 요구사항에 대응하기 위해, 단순 운영을 넘어 LLM/AI를 활용해 DB 운영의 반복 업무를 자동화하고, 쿼리 튜닝·장애 진단·용량 산정 등 DBA의 의사결정을 가속화하는 데이터베이스 운영 환경을 구축하는 것을 목표로 합니다. 본 포지션은 기존 운영 방식을 그대로 답습하는 자리가 아니라, 새로운 DB 운영 방법론을 발전시키고 기술적 지도력을 발휘하여 자동화 체계를 설계·도입·확산하는 역할입니다.

이 팀에서 함께할 동료에게 기대하는 점:

  • 대규모 트래픽 환경의 RDBMS 운영에서 겪은 한계를 자동화AI 기반 접근으로 돌파해 본 경험

  • 개발팀과 적극적으로 소통하며 스키마 설계쿼리 리뷰·성능 개선을 함께 풀어가실 분

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

jobs.title: Art Director
jobs.description:
Skydance Animation is seeking an Art Director to help shape the visual identity of an upcoming animated feature film. This role is central to defining and executing the overall look and feel of the film, ensuring a cohesive and compelling visual experience that supports both story and character.

The Art Director will report to the Production Designer and will work in close partnership with the Director and the rest of the creative leadership team to bring the film’s visual vision to life, translating conceptual ideas into a clear and actionable visual direction for the broader art team. Throughout production, they will collaborate across departments, including environments, characters, lighting, and effects, to maintain artistic consistency and elevate the quality of every frame.

This position requires a strong artistic sensibility, a deep understanding of visual storytelling, and the ability to lead and inspire artists in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment. The ideal candidate is both a visionary and a problem-solver and someone who can balance creative ambition with production realities while pushing the film’s aesthetic to new heights.

Prior experience on an animated feature film is required.

jobs.title: [Studio Support Div.] Tech Ops Lead (10년 이상)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

Studio Support Division(SSD)은 크래프톤 HQ 산하 조직으로, 다수의 게임 개발 스튜디오에 Art, Audio, Localization, 외주 관리 등 제작 지원을 제공합니다. 신설되는 Tech Ops 실은 게임 프로젝트의 기술 리스크를 진단하고, 스튜디오와 함께 문제를 해결하는 역할을 담당합니다. 크래프톤의 다양한 스튜디오와 프로젝트를 대상으로 서버와 클라이언트 양 영역에 걸친 기술 진단과 문제 해결을 주도하며, 단일 프로젝트에서는 얻기 어려운 폭넓은 임팩트를 경험할 수 있습니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • Tech Ops 실 조직 구성 및 운영 (서버/클라이언트 엔지니어 팀 빌딩)
  • 게임 프로젝트 기술 진단(DD) 프레임워크 설계 및 고도화
  • 스튜디오 프로젝트 대상 기술 진단 수행 및 개선 방향 제시
  • 스튜디오 엔지니어링 팀과의 협업을 통한 기술 리스크 조기 식별 및 해결 지원
  • 프로젝트 경험에서 축적된 기술 노하우의 자산화 및 전사 공유

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다!

  • 게임 서버 또는 게임 클라이언트 엔지니어링 중 적어도 하나에서 5년 이상의 실무 경력
  • 해당 영역에서 기술적 문제를 독립적으로 진단하고 해결한 경험
  • 나머지 영역(서버 또는 클라이언트)에 대한 기본적인 이해
  • 다수의 이해관계자와 협업하며 기술 방향을 조율한 경험
  • 명확한 기술 커뮤니케이션 능력 (비엔지니어 포함 대상)

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다!

jobs.title: [AI Transformation Dept.] Sr. AI Data Pipeline Specialist (7년 이상)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

"AI First 크래프톤을 완성하는 데이터의 심장, AXD Data Foundation 팀"
크래프톤 AX(AI Transformation)는 전사에 AI를 도입하여, 데이터와 인프라를 기반으로 임직원들의 워크(Work)와 워크플로우(Workflow) 자동화를 가속화하고 그 압도적인 효율화 성과를 전사로 확산하는 핵심 조직입니다.
Data Foundation 팀은 파편화된 전사 데이터를 통합하고, AI(LLM, AI Agent 등)가 즉각적으로 학습하고 활용할 수 있는 최적의 데이터 파이프라인과 아키텍처를 설계하고 구축합니다. 크래프톤의 거대한 데이터를 다루며, AI 기술의 최전선에서 사내 업무 혁신을 직접 구현해 낼 열정적인 데이터 엔지니어를 모십니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • AI 데이터 활용 전략 분석 및 파이프라인 아키텍처 설계: 전사 데이터 소스를 독자적으로 분석하고, AI(LLM, RAG 시스템 등)가 최적으로 활용할 수 있는 데이터 파이프라인 구조를 연구·설계
  • 비정형 데이터 처리 방법론 연구 및 전처리 전략 기획: 사내 위키, Slack, 문서 등 대규모 비정형 데이터의 특성을 분석하고, Vector DB 서빙을 위한 최적 전처리·가공 방법론을 독자적으로 수립
  • 데이터 품질 분석 및 거버넌스 기준 수립: 데이터 정합성·완결성을 정량적으로 분석하고, 품질 모니터링 지표 및 거버넌스 기준을 기획·수립
  • Modern Data Stack 기술 리서치 및 도입 전략 기획: 빠르게 변화하는 데이터 엔지니어링 기술 트렌드를 지속적으로 연구하고, 크래프톤 환경에 최적화된 기술 스택 도입 방안을 분석·제안
  • 담당 기술 영역 내 ETL/ELT 파이프라인 아키텍처를 독자적으로 판단·설계하고, Data Warehouse/Data Lake 구축에 반영
  • 파이프라인 안정성 확보를 위한 자동화 방안을 자율적으로 분석·설계하고 장애 대응 체계 수립

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 데이터 엔지니어링 관련 분야 7년 이상의 전문 경력을 보유하신 분
  • Python, SQL 등을 활용한 데이터 처리에 능숙하며, 독자적으로 데이터 파이프라인 아키텍처를 분석·설계하고 전략을 수립·실행할 수 있는 역량을 갖추신 분
  • AWS, GCP 등 클라우드 환경 기반의 데이터 시스템에 대한 깊은 이해도를 보유하신 분
  • Airflow, Spark, Kafka 등 데이터 분산 처리 및 오케스트레이션 도구에 대한 전문적 활용 역량이 있으신 분
  • 데이터베이스(RDBMS, NoSQL, DW 등) 구조를 심층적으로 이해하고, 비즈니스 요구에 맞는 기술적 해결책을 독자적으로 도출할 수 있는 분

jobs.title: [AI Transformation Dept.] Sr. AI Transformation Specialist (FDE) (7년 이상)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

"현장의 가장 깊숙한 곳에 투입되어, AI로 비즈니스 병목을 파괴하는 스페셜리스트"

크래프톤 AX(AI Transformation)는 전사에 AI를 도입하여 임직원들의 일하는 방식(Work & Workflow)을 혁신하는 핵심 조직입니다.

AXD FDE(Forward Deployed Engineer) 팀은 전통적인 개발 조직처럼 백오피스에 머물지 않습니다. 현업(게임 제작 스튜디오, 글로벌 퍼블리싱, 백오피스 등)의 한가운데로 직접 투입되어, 그들이 겪는 치명적인 비즈니스 Pain Point를 발굴하고 AI 기술을 통해 즉각적인 솔루션을 만들어냅니다. 전사 AI 해커톤을 이끌고, 최단 시간 내에 MVP(최소 기능 제품)를 런칭하여 '기술이 어떻게 재무적/시간적 성과로 이어지는지'를 현장에서 직접 증명해 낼 강인하고 속도감 있는 FDE 팀을 모십니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • AI 혁신 전략 수립 및 자문: 현업 부서의 비즈니스 과제를 분석하여 AI 적용 전략을 독자적으로 수립하고, 기술적 방향성 및 우선순위에 대한 전문적 자문 제시
  • 비즈니스 요구사항 분석 및 아키텍처 설계: 비개발 직군(기획, 재무, HR 등)의 복잡한 요구사항을 정확히 분석·해석하고, 이를 AI 기반의 아키텍처로 설계 및 구현
  • AI 기술 도입 타당성 연구 및 ROI 분석: 도입된 AI 기술의 실제 비용 절감 및 업무 시간 단축 효과를 정량적으로 분석·연구하고, 성공 사례를 전사 스케일업(Scale-up) 전략으로 기획
  • 현업 밀착형 AI 프로토타이핑 및 해커톤 기획: 현업 부서와 직접 호흡하며 비즈니스 문제를 정의하고, 단기간(며칠~몇 주) 내에 AI 에이전트 및 자동화 앱을 설계·프로토타이핑하여 기술 검증 수행 (사내 AI 해커톤 등 전사 혁신 이니셔티브 기술 총괄 포함)

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 관련 분야 7년 이상의 전문 경력을 보유하신 분
  • 소프트웨어 엔지니어링 실무 경력을 바탕으로, 개발 팀이나 목적 조직(TF)을 리딩하여 프로젝트를 성공적으로 완수한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 프론트엔드부터 백엔드까지 (Full-stack) 폭넓은 개발 이해도를 바탕으로, 요구사항 분석부터

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Community
jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Role

The Community team builds products that allow creators to build and grow communities on Twitch. Our products span across creator and viewer journeys. As a Senior Product Manager on the Discovery team, you will own the experience that helps viewers find creators worth coming back for, across search, browse, and serendipitous discovery in the live feed. Your work will focus on helping viewers form their first creator connection and every connection after it, because that bond is what turns an occasional visit into a daily habit. You will be the voice of the viewer for recommendations: defining what viewers want, surfacing what they are not seeing but should, owning the discovery roadmap, and partnering with our ML teams to turn those needs into better ranking and relevance. You will define and execute a product strategy grounded in customer needs, working closely with applied science, design, and engineering to ship and measure your way there.

Our team is based in San Francisco, CA but you can work from San Francisco, CA; New York, NY; Irvine, CA; Los Angeles, CA or Seattle, WA.

You Will:

  • Own the discovery experience across search, browse, and the live feed, helping viewers find creators worth returning for and form their first connection and every one after it.
  • Define what viewers want from recommendations and what they are not seeing but should, and own the discovery roadmap that closes those gaps.
  • Partner closely with applied scientists, ML product managers, and engineers to translate viewer needs int

jobs.title: [HR Div.] Developer Relations Program Manager (3년 ~ 5년 / 계약직)
jobs.description:

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

KRAFTON은 각기 다른 크리에이티브 아이덴티티와 강점을 가진 약 20개 이상의 글로벌 스튜디오로 구성되어 있으며, 국내에만 14개의 스튜디오가 존재합니다. 다양한 위치에서 다양한 프로젝트를 진행하고 있지만, 우리는 모두 하나의 KRAFTON Family입니다.

KDC (KRAFTON Developers Connect)는 KRAFTON Family가 하나로 모일 수 있는 장으로, 서로 다른 배경과 경험을 가진 사람들이 교류하며 창의성(Creativity)을 더욱 발전시킬 수 있다고 믿습니다.

2011년 전사 차원의 지식 공유와 기술 교류를 목적으로 시작된 KDC는 지난 15년간 유관 업계 종사자, 전 세계 스튜디오 및 파트너들과 지속적으로 교류하며 범 크래프톤 차원의 연결을 확장해 왔습니다.
KDC 팀은 KRAFTON의 다양한 신작 개발 및 독립 스튜디오 간의 '연결'을 통해 상호 이해를 증진시키고, 개발자 간 지식과 경험이 활발하게 유통될 수 있도록 커뮤니티를 설계하고 운영하는 역할을 합니다.

이를 위해 KDC 팀은 세미나, 핸즈온 워크숍, 해커톤, 직군별 밋업 등 다양한 형식의 프로그램을 기획·운영합니다.
단순히 보고 듣는 것을 넘어 경험을 공유하고, 인사이트를 얻으며, 의미 있는 네트워크를 형성할 수 있도록 — '인정 → 자극 → 동기부여 → 성장 → 새로운 기회'로 이어지는 크래프톤만의 선순환 개발 문화를 만들어가는 것이 우리의 목표입니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 개발자 간 기술/개발 교류 모임 (밋업, 워크샵, 세미나 등) 지원
  • 전사 직무 관련 교육 기획 및 운영 (개발/퍼블리싱/AI 등)
  • KRAFTON의 주요 사업과 전략에 대한 깊이 있는 이해를 바탕으로 아젠다와 연사를 적극적으로 발굴하고 기획에 반영
  • KRAFTON 내외부 개발자 간 소통을 활성화하기 위한 방안을 함께 고민하고 지원
  • 컨퍼런스, 해커톤, 게임잼 등의 개발 행사 기획 및 운영

jobs.title: [Art Dept.] Technical Art (5년 이상 / 계약직)
jobs.description:

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.


Art Department 소개

Art Department는 크래프톤 게임 스튜디오의 아트 프로덕션 전반에 필요한 그래픽 기술과 솔루션을 지원하는 조직입니다. 그래픽 기술과 제작 파이프라인을 기반으로, 게임 개발팀이 빠르고 안정적으로 프로젝트를 시작하고 확장할 수 있도록 지원하며, 크래프톤만의 차별화된 아트 기술 서비스를 제공합니다
Art Dept는 “Scale-up the Creative”와 “AI-first”라는 회사 방향성 아래, 장인정신에 기반한 높은 퀄리티, 데이터 기반 최적화, 그리고 제작 효율화를 핵심 가치로 삼고 있습니다.
조직 구성원은 Advanced 그래픽 기술과 최신 트렌드를 선도하며, 전사 스튜디오를 대상으로 최적화된 제작 가이드라인을 제시하는 기술 파트너로서 역할을 수행합니다. 단순한 툴 지원을 넘어, 제작 과정에서 발생하는 기술적 병목을 선제적으로 해결하고, 스튜디오와의 협업(Co-development)을 통해 최상의 개발 경험을 제공합니다.
Art Department는 경험과 신뢰를 바탕으로 국내외 다양한 스튜디오를 지원하며, 지속적으로 성과를 만들어가고 있습니다. 크래프톤 게임이 높은 그래픽 완성도를 갖추고 성공적으로 시장에 출시될 수 있도록, 함께 성장할 전문가를 기다립니다.

Visual R&D 팀을 소개합니다.

Visual R&D 팀은 KRAFTON Art Department 산하 조직으로, 예술적 창의성(Art)과 기술적 구현(Technology)의 시너지를 극대화하는 역할을 수행합니다.
우리는 게임 개발 과정에서 마주하는 다양한 난제를 해결하고, 크래프톤 산하 글로벌 스튜디오들이 최고의 퀄리티를 효율적으로 구현할 수 있도록 최적화된 솔루션과 제작 환경을 제공합니다.
현재 우리는 인게임 캐릭터 제작의 혁신을 목표로 하는 'VCC(Visual R&D Character Customization)' 프로젝트를 비롯하여, 차세대 그래픽 기술 연구와 개발 프로세스 고도화 업무를 주도하고 있습니다.
우리의 목표는 단순한 R&D를 넘어, 실제 프로젝트에 즉시 적용되어 성과를 낼 수 있는 실용적인 기준을 만드는 것입니다.
우리는 지금, 변화하는 개발 환경 속에서 유연한 사고와 협업을 통해 새로운 가치를 창출하고 프로젝트의 완성도를 높여갈 인재를 찾고 있습니다.
각 분야의 전문성을 바탕으로 크래프톤 전사 프로젝트의 성공을 함께 지원하고 성장하고 싶은 분들의 도전을 기다립니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 테크니컬 아트 문제 해결

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Ads
jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Role

Ads on Twitch aren't like ads anywhere else. They happen live, in front of communities that are actively engaged and they directly fund the creators those communities love. This is a genuinely unsolved problem: you won't be optimizing a mature system, you'll be defining what the next generation of live-stream advertising looks like.

We're looking for an engineering leader to run multiple teams building ad experiences that feel native to live streaming. You'll own the technical vision for how ads work on Twitch and lead the org to ship it. Your work will have direct revenue impact and visibility to senior leadership - it shows up on the P&L. The org is at a stage where your leadership decisions will shape its culture for years, and you'll work alongside strong cross-functional partners who care deeply about creators.

This role demands someone who can formulate intuition and opinions grounded in first-principles understanding, not just pattern-matching from past playbooks. You'll navigate both technical and product ambiguity simultaneously, leading entirely autonomously rather than relying on a hierarchy to set direction. This is a very fast-paced environment where leading teams to results and delivering resounding impact is the expectation.

You can work in San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA.

You Will:

  • Own the engineering strategy for ad products across multiple teams
  • Make real architectural calls - we're actively evolving how ads are served, targeted, and measured in a live-streaming context

Community Trust (CT) exists to foster an environment where streamers and their communities thrive, while proactively reducing harm and ensuring support is accessible when needed. jobs.description:
Skydance Games, a division of Paramount, a Skydance Corporation, is building the future of franchise-driven interactive entertainment. As part of a global storytelling company defined by iconic worlds and multigenerational fandom, we see gaming not as an extension of our brands, but as one of the most powerful ways their stories come to life and evolve alongside the audiences who love them.

Through creativity, collaboration, and trust, we empower our teams to push boundaries and turn bold ideas into experiences that resonate with fans around the world.

Do you want to craft games that challenge expectations and inspire players? Come build something extraordinary with us.

---

Why Join Us?
To put it simply: You’ll work with great people, making top-tier, high-quality interactive experiences for the highly acclaimed new title, “Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra”.  We have assembled the best external development, publishing and IP partners in the world. Our internal team will remain small relative to other AAA developers so we can all maintain the highest levels of familiarity, trust and effectiveness. You’ll be surrounded by industry veterans, currently with an average of 20 years’ experience, in a climate of mutual trust, maturity, candor and playful collaboration. We believe that life’s too short to work with difficult people, regardless of talent, so exceptional character and strong principles are requirements for every role. Your days will be focused on solving creative and technical problems, not navigating corporate politics.
Currently for this role, we can hire remote candidates with legal residence in Arizona, California, Florida, Michigan, New York, North Carolina, Texas, Washington and Canada.
What You’ll Do:
We are searching for an Audio Lead to join our core team developing a high-quality AAA single-player story- driven action-adventure game built using the Unreal Engine. As Audio Lead, you will define the creative vision, technical direction, and production standards for all audio in the project. You will guide, mentor, and support the sound design teams, ensuring our audio deepens immersion, strengthens gameplay clarity, and enhances emotional impact. We only hire talented, collaborative people with strong communication skills who are laser focused on achieving excellent results.

jobs.title: Costume Designer
jobs.description:
Skydance Animation is seeking a Costume Designer to lead the design and execution of wardrobe across all characters, from leads to crowds, ensuring visual consistency throughout our film. As a key member of the art leadership team, the role will collaborate closely with the Director, Production Designer, Lead Character Designer, and report directly to the studio’s Head of Costume Design.
This position is responsible for defining and maintaining the film’s distinctive visual style through clothing, hairstyles, and accessories while finding innovative and researched ways to enhance character performance, express personality, and elevate the storytelling.
The ideal candidate combines strong creative vision with deep technical expertise in garment construction, tailoring, fabrics, and sewing techniques. The Costume Designer will play a pivotal role in mentoring and guiding the broader team, providing clear instruction on costume preparation and packeting from both a costume and visual development perspective.
Previous experience as a visual development artist in animation is required.

jobs.title: Character Designer
jobs.description:
Skydance Animation is seeking an experienced Character Designer to join our team on an upcoming feature film. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in bringing stories to life by shaping the look, personality, and visual identity of our characters. From early concept exploration to final design execution, you will craft compelling, expressive designs that resonate with both the narrative and audience.
Working closely with directors, art leads, and fellow creatives, the Character Designer will contribute to the development of unique character styles, produce high-quality design assets, and help maintain a cohesive visual language throughout the film. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in drawing, a keen sense of storytelling through design, and the versatility to explore a wide range of shapes, styles, and emotional expression.
Previous experience on a feature animated film is required.

This position is based in Los Angeles, California, and requires the selected candidate to work in an on-site hybrid capacity.
